traceability.notes:
Based on code, tests, and user-facing documentation, Story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG appears fully implemented.
All of the technical requirements from the story are implemented and covered by tests that explicitly reference this story file: - REQ-CONFIG-PRESETS and REQ-FLAT-CONFIG are satisfied by the flat-config preset arrays in src/index.ts and the FlatESLint integration tests that use them as documented. - REQ-RULE-OPTIONS and REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION are satisfied by rule schemas (e.g., require-story-annotation, valid-story-reference) with additionalProperties: false and dedicated tests in tests/config/*.test.ts. - REQ-PROJECT-INTEGRATION is addressed by the comprehensive ESLint v9 flat-config setup guide and examples for JS, TS, mixed projects, monorepos, and test files. - REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS is effectively implemented under the name REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS in the valid-story-reference rule and its tests/docs; although the requirement ID differs, the behavior (custom story directories, absolute-path handling, extension requirements) clearly matches the specification’s intent.
The acceptance criterion for error handling of invalid configuration options is also met: invalid branchTypes, invalid regex patterns, and unknown rule options all result in controlled ESLint diagnostics rather than crashes, with tests verifying these cases. Documentation for configuration and troubleshooting is extensive across README.md and user-docs.
One minor inconsistency is that the requirement ID in the story (REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS) does not match the ID used in the implementation and tests (REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS), but the implemented behavior aligns with the described requirement. Given the strong test coverage, correct runtime behavior, and rich documentation, this story is assessed as PASSED.
